adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered the missing source-backed activity matrices from XML Tables 2-4, reconciled linked APD6/DBAASP rows against primary table values and sequence/modification evidence, and closed the prior rework ticket with explicit cautions for target-label conflict, modified-sequence database normalization, and figure-only exact values.

materials_exhausted.note: Bounded local review reopened XML tables, PDF/extracted text, figure captions, supplementary ZIP/PDF, OA package inventory, and linked database snapshots. Remaining exact figure-series values are nonblocking and not fabricated.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Primary Table 1 sequence/name evidence and Tables 2-4 activity rows support most linked DBAASP assay rows; sequence-modification and exact hemolysis figure conflicts are preserved as cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: XML Tables 2-4 were manually parsed into row-level MIC/MBC, MBIC/MBEC, and IC50 records with target labels, units, and locators; prose-supported hemolysis, PC-3 viability, and larval efficacy context are included without fabricating figure datapoints.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Direct bacterial membrane permeabilization is supported by SYTOX assay source locators; time-kill, in vivo, and cell-viability findings are kept as phenotype/context claims.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Tables 2-3 and linked DBAASP rows use E. faecium/NTCC 12697; body/method prose also uses E. faecalis/NCTC 12697. Activity rows preserve the table header and carry a source_conflict_note.

Several APD6/DBAASP analogue sequence rows omit or underlabel C-terminal amidation that primary Table 1 prints as -NH2; database_record_verification.json preserves these as sequence_modified_not_normalized/source_conflict cases instead of smoothing them.
Figure 11/prose support qualitative and approximate haemolysis findings; exact DBAASP hemolysis bins are retained as source_conflict unless a local source table supports them exactly.
The local supplementary ZIP contains a PDF with Ramachandran/HPLC/MALDI figure captions; no supplementary activity/toxicity table was recovered from local material.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Figures 6-11 are available as images/captions and prose summaries, but the local XML/PDF does not contain machine-readable per-timepoint or per-dose numeric data tables for those curves.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Nonblocking: source-supported table values for MIC/MBC, MBIC/MBEC, IC50, and prose-supported toxicity/in vivo context were captured; exact figure-series datapoints are preserved as caution rather than fabricated.
